transcript: Okay, so I have a Schmigadoon fan theory that I haven't really seen anyone else talking about, so I was like, I'm gonna talk about it. This theory involves Alan coming Sweeney Todd like character. And if you've seen Sweeney Todd, you know that there is a plot twist of sorts at the end of the show. And if you have not seen Sweeney Todd, I'm about to spoil said plot twist, so please continue watching at your own warning. So in episode 3, it was revealed that Alan Cumming, similar to Sweeney Todd, had a wife and a daughter, which were taken from him by the Judge Turpin like character that Patrick Page plays. And just like in Sweeney Todd, the wife is presumed dead. And just like in Sweeney Todd, I believe that Alan Cummings wife is not only still alive, but also someone that we've already met. I believe that at the end of the series, it will be revealed that the altering to that lady is actually Alan Cumming wife, similar to how Bigger Woman is revealed to actually be Sweeney Todd wife in the musical. I think the fact that she is a Joanne from company parody is a bit of a red herring. I think they want us to just think it's like this fun little running gag as kind of a nod to company, and that's kind of why she's there in the story. But I think that there's a lot more to Her than meets the eye. And Schmigadoon is no stranger to mashing up different character archetypes. So, for example, Kristin Chenoweth playing a mashup of Mrs. Lovett and Miss Hannigan. I think it's very possible that this character could be a mashup of both Joanne from company and the Beggar Woman from Sweeney Todd. Which, of course, raises the question, will she survive the series? Because on one hand, in the actual show Sweeney Todd, she is killed off before her true identity is revealed. And they told us in the opening number, endings that are tragic. So we should expect a tragic ending. But at the same time, Josh and Melissa need a happy ending to get out of Chicago, and this certainly would not be a very happy ending. So I'm not really sure which direction they'll go with it. I'm curious to get your thoughts, though. Do you think that this theory is right? Do you think she will survive the series? Do you think that she will meet a similar fate to Beg Woman? I'd love to hear your thoughts on this theory. I haven't heard anyone else talk about it, so I'm curious if you think I'm on the right track or if you think I'm completely off base.
